curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can humanity reverse this trend within ten years by changing its consumption pattern?
curatedMovie.description: In 200,000 years, humanity has disrupted billions of years of planetary balance. Yann Arthus-Bertrand surveys the scale of resource depletion, global warming, and extinction threatening Earth.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Thoughtful and emotionally heavy, this steady French documentary demands engaged focus on humanity's shared home.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Arthus-Bertrand trades despair for direct urgency, pairing planetary scope with a clear call to rethink global consumption before time runs out.
